name: com.aim4code.nanoserviceflow
description:
A lightweight, Zustand-inspired state management and event-driven architecture for modern Unity, with no third-party dependencies.

Key Features:
▪ Unidirectional Data Flow with reducers and side-effects
▪ Built-in constructor injection & automated Action routing
▪ ReactiveProperty<T> with allocation-free updates, plus ReactiveSignal<T> for one-shot events
▪ Extensible Middleware pipeline for logging and analytics
▪ Async-agnostic side-effects (Task, UniTask)
